entry.title: Improved Polymath Bounds on Dense Progression-Free Sets in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ and Formalization in Lean 4
entry.summary:
We establish a sharper upper bound of $(c p)^{n}$ with $c < 0.841$ for subsets of $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ lacking three-term arithmetic progressions via slice-rank polynomial spectral stability. The core combinatorial reduction and spectral lemma have been fully mechanized in Lean 4 against Mathlib, uncovering a tighter constant than the classical Ellenberg-Gijswijt bound in low characteristic.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (math.NT) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #formal-proofs

entry.title: Byzantine Fault Injection and Split-Brain Recovery in Consensus-Backed Object Stores
entry.summary:
Deterministic simulation testing across five Raft and Paxos storage engines reveals stale reads under asymmetric network partitions coupled with NVMe fsync stalls. We present a formal TLA+ invariant checker that reproduces linearizability violations in under $40\text{ seconds}$ of simulated cluster time.

Source: Jepsen / Distributed Systems · Tags: #distributed-systems #databases #formal-proofs

entry.title: Verified Tool-Use Trajectories for Multi-Step Coding Agents via Formal Preconditions
entry.summary:
Autonomous coding agents frequently execute destructive shell or filesystem mutations when intermediate hypotheses fail. We attach lightweight Hoare-style state preconditions to MCP tool schemas, pruning invalid action branches before execution and raising SWE-bench Verified pass rates by $11.4\%$ with $32\%$ fewer token rollouts.

Source: arXiv AI (cs.LG) · Tags: #agents #llm #formal-proofs

entry.title: Symbolic & SMT-Guided Equivalence Checking for EVM Bytecode and ZK-Circuit Compilers
entry.summary:
Under-constrained arithmetic gates in zkSNARK circuits and storage-aliasing bugs in Solidity/Yul compilers account for the majority of critical protocol exploits. We present an SMT-backed relational verifier that proves bit-exact equivalence between optimized EVM bytecode and Plonkish constraint systems in polynomial time for loop-bounded contracts.

Source: arXiv Cryptography (cs.CR) · Tags: #smart-contracts #formal-proofs #zkp
